### Package Installation

```{r include=FALSE}

install.packages("tidyverse")

```

### Reading all csv files

```{r}
library(data.table)
species <- fread("data/899_Species.csv") 
synonyms <- fread("data/synonyms.csv")
traits <- fread("data/traits.csv")
observation <- fread("data/observation.csv")
survey_header <- fread("data/header.csv")
location <- fread("data/location.csv")
```

### Perform any data manipulation here:

#### Observations Table

##### 1. Rename columns

```{r}
library(data.table) 
## Rename columns 
observations <- fread("data/observation.csv")
setnames(observations, old = c("sd_ID", "sd_SpeciesORIG","sd_quality", "sd_Breeding"), new = c("survey_id","species_id", "survey_quality", "breeding_status"), skip_absent = TRUE)   
colnames(observations) 
```

```{r}
# removing rejected records from observation table
unique(observations$survey_quality)  

```

```{r}
species <- fread("data/899_Species.csv")

colnames(species) 
```

#### Header Table

```{r}
survey_header <- fread("data/header.csv")  

old_names = c("s_ID", "s_Atlasser", "s_StartF", "s_DateL", "s_Latitude", "s_Longitude", "s_Locality", "k_Latitude", "k_Longitude", "observation_count", "s_Qualifier", "s_Notes")  
new_names = c("survey_id", "survey_atlasser", "survey_start", "survey_end", "latitude", "longitude", "survey_location", "key_latitude", "key_longitude", "observation_count", "survey_qualifier", "survey_notes")
setnames(survey_header, old_names, new_names, skip_absent = TRUE)  

# fix key_lat and key_longitude 



ddmm_to_decmial <- function(point, south = FALSE) {
  degree <- point %/% 100 # whole degrees 
  minute <- point %% 100 

  
  converted_point <- degree + (minute / 60) 
  
  # minutes 
  if (south) -converted_point 
  else converted_point
}

survey_header[, key_latitude := ddmm_to_decmial(key_latitude, TRUE)]
survey_header[, key_longitude := ddmm_to_decmial(key_longitude, FALSE)] 


colnames(survey_header)
```

### Make new tables via joins

##### Adding a column for species names

```{r}
# make sure join keys are the same type (bit you before with DB_Code)
species[, species_id := as.character(species_id)]
observations[, species_id := as.character(species_id)]

setkey(species, species_id)
setkey(observations, species_id)

observations <- observations[species, on = "species_id"]
```

```{r}
# observations don't have any spatial information 
# Survey header has lat, long, loc 

setkey(observations, survey_id) 
setkey(survey_header, survey_id) 

observations <- observations[survey_header, on = "survey_id",.(survey_id, species_id, species_name, species_sciname, survey_location, key_latitude, key_longitude, survey_quality, survey_start, survey_end, confidence_Level, survey_notes)] 
colnames(observations)
```

### Data Viz

##### Plot all bird observations on a single map

```{r}
bird_locations <- observations[, c('species_name','key_latitude', 'key_longitude')]
bird_locations
```

```{r}
library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(ozmaps)

bird_locations[, `:=`(key_latitude  = as.numeric(key_latitude),
                      key_longitude = as.numeric(key_longitude))]

nsw_x <- c(140.5, 164)
nsw_y <- c(-37.7, -28)

pts <- bird_locations[!is.na(key_latitude) & !is.na(key_longitude) &
                        key_latitude  %between% nsw_y &
                        key_longitude %between% nsw_x]

sp   <- NULL   # set to NULL to map all species
cell <- 0.1                  # grid size in degrees (~10 km)

dat  <- if (is.null(sp)) pts else pts[species_name == sp]

grid <- dat[, .(n = .N),
            by = .(lon = floor(key_longitude / cell) * cell + cell / 2,
                   lat = floor(key_latitude  / cell) * cell + cell / 2)]

nsw_heat <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = ozmap_states, fill = "grey97", colour = NA) +
  geom_tile(data = grid, aes(lon, lat, fill = n), width = cell, height = cell) +
  geom_sf(data = ozmap_states, fill = NA, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", option = "inferno", direction = -1,
                       name = "# of observations", labels = scales::comma) +
  coord_sf(xlim = nsw_x, ylim = nsw_y) +
  labs(title = if (is.null(sp)) "Heatmap of Bird Observations in NSW" else sp) +
  theme_void()

nsw_heat
ggsave("nsw_heatmap.png", nsw_heat, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

### Endangered status of species

```{r}
nsw_birds <- species$species_sciname
birds_with_traits <- traits$Scientific_Name
length(intersect(nsw_birds, birds_with_traits))

nsw_birds_with_traits <- species[traits, on = .(species_sciname == Scientific_Name), nomatch = NULL] 
```

```{r}
unique(nsw_birds_with_traits$ALA_IUCN)
status_freq <- nsw_birds_with_traits[, .N, by = ALA_IUCN]
status_freq
extinct_birds <- nsw_birds_with_traits[ALA_IUCN == "EN", .(species_sciname, ALA_IUCN)]
extinct_birds
```
